Name: Mod Sync Check
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[b]Mod Sync Check[/b] stops a player from joining your multiplayer farm until their mods and mod versions match yours. No more broken sessions because someone forgot to update a mod or is missing one entirely.

When a player tries to join, the host compares mod lists [i]before[/i] the game lets them in. A player whose mods don't match never enters the world; they're told why, and if they have Mod Sync Check too, they can download the missing or outdated mods straight from the host and rejoin after a restart. Where the host still has the original files from Nexus Mods, the player checks each one against Nexus Mods before installing it, so they don't have to take the host's word for it.

It can also keep everyone on the host's mod settings for the session, so all players run the same configuration without anyone editing files by hand.

[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod from the [b]Files[/b] tab and unzip it into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Every player should install it, not just the host.[/b] By default the host blocks players who don't have Mod Sync Check, and a player needs it to download mods from the host or use the host's settings.

No longer do you need to unzip or "install" mods! Just put the .zip files in your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder. In fact, this is preferable! Mods sent from the host to the joining player can then be validated by Nexus Mods.

[i]Optional:[/i] install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the settings in-game. Otherwise, edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] that is created in the mod's folder the first time you launch the game.

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Mod and version check on join.[/b] The host checks each joining player's mods before the game approves them. Mismatched players are blocked before they enter the world. A player with an older version of a mod than the host's, or a different major version, is blocked; a newer minor or patch update is fine.[/*]
[*][b]Clear reasons.[/b] A blocked player sees why on their farmhand selection screen, even without the mod, along with where to get Mod Sync Check. Players who have the mod get a dialog listing the missing and wrong-version mods, and the full list is always written to the SMAPI log.[/*]
[*][b]Download mods from the host.[/b] If both sides have the mod, a blocked player can download what they're missing or have at a different version, sent directly by the host. Mods are only added or updated, never removed. Replaced versions are backed up to [font=Courier New]Mods/.ModSyncCheck/backup[/font], and the game offers to restart afterwards.[/*]
[*][b]Original files, checked against Nexus Mods.[/b] If the host still has the .zip it downloaded a mod in, at the same version, it sends that file unchanged. The joining player looks up its hash on Nexus Mods (no account or API key needed) and installs it only if it's a file from that mod's own Nexus Mods page. Only that mod's folder is installed, so other mods bundled in the same file are left out.[/*]
[*][b]Choose what to get.[/b] The dialog lists mods under [b]Verifiable[/b] (original files that Nexus Mods can confirm) and [b]Unverifiable[/b] (everything else). Verifiable mods are ticked by default; unverifiable ones need "I know the host personally and trust them". Afterwards the player is shown which mods they still need.[/*]
[*][b]Changed files are caught.[/b] If a file the host sends as an original doesn't match the mod's files on Nexus Mods, the player is warned that the host changed it. Without trust it's deleted unopened, and that mod is listed as unverifiable from that host next time. The "I know the host personally and trust them", will need to be checked for that mod to be downloaded from the host. [/*]
[*][b]Links to Nexus Mods.[/b] In the mismatch dialog, each mod with a Nexus update key links to its Nexus Mods page, so a player who doesn't trust the host can get it themselves.[/*]
[*][b]Shared settings.[/b] While in your game, players use the host's settings for the required mods. Their own [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] files are not changed, and they get their own settings back when they leave. If the host changes a setting mid-game, joined players receive the updated settings; again, their local config files are never changed.[/*]
[*][b](Host) Choose what must match.[/b] Mark any mod as required for the client to have. Common client-only mods (such as Lookup Anything, NPC Map Locations and UI Info Suite 2) are ignored by default. and extra mods that the joining player has are always allowed (as vanilla already does).[/*]
[*][b]Per-mod settings sync.[/b] Choose for each mod whether players use your settings or keep their own.[/*]
[*][b]Version notice.[/b] A joining player is told when the host is running a newer or older version of Mod Sync Check.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Mods can run any code on your computer. Verifiable mods are checked against Nexus Mods before they're installed, but unverifiable ones come straight from the host, so only tick the "trust box" for hosts you know. If Nexus Mods can't be reached, an original file is only installed, unverified, when you've ticked the "trust box".[/*]
[*]Mods the host has no original file for are sent from the host's mod folder and can't be verified. Download the mod yourself from Nexus Mods, links are provided when possible, or check the "I trust the host" box.[/*]
[*]Content packs and a few mods can't have their settings changed while the game is running, so those keep the player's own settings.[/*]
[*]Settings are never synced for certain mods that require the config file itself to be changed. [/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Roadmap[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Add an option for the client to get the [i][font=Courier New]config.json[/font][/i] file from the host for mods that cannot have their config changed mid-game, and must load any configs from the launch of the game.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[b]Required[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]The latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[/list][b]Optional[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], to edit the settings in-game instead of in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[/list]For the full feature set (mod downloads and shared settings), both the host and the joining players need Mod Sync Check installed.
